lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots are arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. In the mid-lateral region, these spots maintain a regular grid-like spatial distribution with roughly equal spacing between centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the vertical columns of spots; the highest-intensity blobs are centered at the intersection points of these vertical bands and the longitudinal carinae.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the lateral flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal-facing edge and lower-intensity shadowing on the ventral-facing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (commensal remoras) is visible near the ventral surface and the posterior edge of the left pectoral fin.
